versions.changelog:
Initial release — skill for tracking sports team fan sentiment on Twitter.

- Monitors Twitter fan sentiment, volume trends, topic themes, event-triggered spikes, and top reactions for sports teams.
- Uses apidojo’s Tweet scraper actor; supports a full range of Twitter search/filter parameters.
- Designed for sports marketing teams, analytics, sponsors, and media.
- Provides detailed workflow, input options, output format, and troubleshooting tips in documentation.
- Classifies sentiment contextually (e.g., WIN_BOOST, LOSS_DROP, CONTROVERSY, BASELINE) and scores results.
